title.en: Harvard’s $699 startup bootcamp offers AI avatars of its instructors
title.zh: 哈佛 699 美元的创业训练营提供其讲师的人工智能头像

summary.en: In the HBS Foundry program, AI avatars provide feedback during practice pitches and board meetings.
summary.zh: 在 HBS Foundry 计划中，人工智能化身在练习推介和董事会会议期间提供反馈。

title.en: Inherent, founded by DeepMind alumni, says its AI ‘teammate’ just outperformed Anthropic and OpenAI at replicating research
title.zh: 由DeepMind校友创立的Inherent表示，其AI “队友”在复制研究方面的表现刚刚超过了Anthropic和OpenAI

summary.en: Built by DeepMind alumni, British AI lab Inherent released Faraday, an AI agent whose ability to replicate scientific papers could be a stepping stone for innovation.
summary.zh: 由 DeepMind 校友创建的英国人工智能实验室 Inherent 发布了 Faraday，这是一款人工智能代理，其复制科学论文的能力可能成为创新的垫脚石。

title.en: Decoding AI’s Open-Source Course Maps Three Ways to Run an Agent Loop and the Provider Economics Behind Each
title.zh: 解码人工智能的开源课程映射了运行代理循环的三种方式以及每种方式背后的提供商经济学

summary.en: Most teams treat ‘which model’ as the important decision. The harness engineering literature keeps pointing somewhere else. In LangChain’s Terminal-Bench experiment, changing only…

title.en: Best GPU Neoclouds 2026: CoreWeave, Nebius, Lambda, Crusoe, and Groq Ranked by Published Pricing and Contracted Power
title.zh: 2026 年最佳 GPU Neocloud：CoreWeave、Nebius、Lambda、Crusoe 和 Groq 按已发布定价和合同功耗排名

summary.en: The five largest GPU neoclouds now run on very different models. CoreWeave and Nebius report to the SEC; Lambda and Crusoe are private and heading toward IPOs; Groq rebuilt itself…
summary.zh: 五个最大的GPU新云现在运行在非常不同的模型上。CoreWeave和Nebius向美国证券交易委员会报告； Lambda和Crusoe是私有的，正在走向IPO ； Groq重建了自己……

title.en: From Atari to EVE Online: Building on 15 Years of AI Research in Games
title.zh: 从 Atari 到 EVE Online：基于 15 年游戏人工智能研究

summary.zh: Google DeepMind 与游戏工作室合作开发突破性人工智能游戏原型。

summary.en: “Runaway” AI, “rogue” agents, and “autonomous” actors—the current rhetoric would have you believe that AI agents are not only awake and aware, but angry at their creators. Promine…

summary.en: Introducing AI Futures, a new OpenAI blog exploring how transformative AI could reshape power, governance, the economy, and individual freedom.
summary.zh: 隆重推出 AI Futures，这是一个新的 OpenAI 博客，探讨变革性人工智能如何重塑权力、治理、经济和个人自由。

title.en: VentureBeat names Rob Strechay as its first Lead Analyst, expanding its enterprise AI research push

title.en: OpenAI and Anthropic in price war as Chinese AI rivals gain ground
title.zh: 随着中国人工智能竞争对手的崛起，OpenAI 和 Anthropic 陷入价格战

summary.en: US groups release cheaper models after new challenges to their trillion-dollar ambitions.
summary.zh: 美国集团在其万亿美元雄心面临新挑战后推出了更便宜的型号。
